QUBI AI · LOCAL LANGUAGE MODEL

From question to report, on your infrastructure.

QUBI AI analyses hotel data without sending it to a cloud AI service. The language model that interprets the question runs in your own environment. The QUBI data model calculates the figures in the report.

01

Interpret the question

For “How many room nights did we sell at each hotel in October?”, the local model identifies room nights as the measure, hotel as the grouping and October as the period.

02

Query authorised data

QUBI applies these selections to its reporting model. The query runs within the reports and properties the user can access. Measures such as revenue and occupancy follow the definitions used in existing reports.

03

Read the result in context

Read the results by property alongside the selected period. To investigate a change, compare the same measure with an earlier period or ask for a breakdown by sales channel.

The website demo runs in your browser using fictional hotel data. Change the property or week to explore answers to the sample questions.

  2. Design the view
